    {"unit":"F005","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses permission indicated by 'may establish'.","statement":"The recipient or subrecipient may establish a threshold higher than the Federal threshold established in the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) in accordance with paragraphs (a)(1)(iv) and (v) of this section.","kind":"permission","modality":"may","references":["§ 200.320(a)(1)(iv)","§ 200.320(a)(1)(v)"]}},

The self-certification must include a justification, clear identification of the threshold, and supporting documentation of any of the following: (A) a qualification as a low-risk auditee in accordance with the criteria in § 200.520 for the most recent audit; (B) an annual internal institutional risk assessment to identify, mitigate, and manage financial risks; or (C) for public institutions, that a higher threshold is consistent with State law.","kind":"requirement","modality":"must","references":["§ 200.334","§ 200.520"]}},

    {"unit":"F011","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses permission indicated by 'may exercise judgment'.","statement":"Unless specified by the Federal agency, when simplified acquisition procedures are used, the recipient or subrecipient may exercise judgment in determining what number of qualified sources is adequate.","kind":"permission","modality":"may"}},
    {"unit":"F012","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses responsibility and a strict limit ('must not exceed').","statement":"The recipient or subrecipient is responsible for determining an appropriate simplified acquisition threshold based on internal controls, an evaluation of risk, and its documented procurement procedures, which may be lower than, but must not exceed, the threshold established in the FAR.","kind":"requirement","modality":"must"}},

    {"unit":"F025","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses mandatory solicitation requirement indicated by 'must be solicited'.","statement":"When proposals are used, proposals must be solicited from multiple qualified entities.","kind":"requirement","modality":"must"}},

    {"unit":"F028","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses permission indicated by 'may use'.","statement":"The recipient or subrecipient may use competitive proposal procedures for qualifications-based procurement of architectural/engineering (A/E) professional services whereby the offeror's qualifications are evaluated, and the most qualified offeror is selected, subject to negotiation of fair and reasonable compensation.","kind":"permission","modality":"may"}},

    {"unit":"F029:F034","unit_attributes":{"modality_explanation":"Expresses a conditional permission restricted to exclusive circumstances ('may only be used if').","statement":"The noncompetitive procurement method may only be used if one of the following circumstances applies: (1) the aggregate amount of the procurement transaction does not exceed the micro-purchase threshold (see paragraph (a)(1) of this section); (2) the procurement transaction can only be fulfilled by a single source; (3) the public exigency or emergency for the requirement will not permit a delay resulting from providing public notice of a competitive solicitation; (4) the recipient or subrecipient requests in writing to use a noncompetitive procurement method, and the Federal agency or pass-through entity provides written approval; or (5) after soliciting several sources, competition is determined inadequate.","kind":"permission","modality":"may","references":["§ 200.320(a)(1)"]}}

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: States descriptive categorization of procurement methods.
unit_attributes.statement: There are three types of procurement methods described in this section: informal procurement methods (for micro-purchases and simplified acquisitions); formal procurement methods (through sealed bids or proposals); and noncompetitive procurement methods.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses an affirmative obligation indicated by 'must maintain and use'.
unit_attributes.statement: For any of the three procurement methods (informal, formal, or noncompetitive), the recipient or subrecipient must maintain and use documented procurement procedures, consistent with the standards of this section and §§ 200.317, 200.318, and 200.319.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: Informal procurement methods may be used when the value of the procurement transaction under the Federal award does not exceed the simplified acquisition threshold as defined in § 200.1.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may also establish'.
unit_attributes.statement: Recipients and subrecipients may also establish a lower threshold for informal procurement methods.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses an advisory recommendation indicated by 'should distribute'.
unit_attributes.statement: To the extent practicable, where the aggregate amount of the procurement transaction does not exceed the micro-purchase threshold defined in § 200.1, the recipient or subrecipient should distribute micro-purchases equitably among qualified suppliers.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission under specified conditions indicated by 'may be awarded'.
unit_attributes.statement: Micro-purchases may be awarded without soliciting competitive price or rate quotations if the recipient or subrecipient considers the price reasonable based on research, experience, purchase history, or other information, and maintains documents to support its conclusion.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: Purchase cards may be used as a method of payment for micro-purchases.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: States responsibility/obligation indicated by 'is responsible for'.
unit_attributes.statement: The recipient or subrecipient is responsible for determining and documenting an appropriate micro-purchase threshold based on internal controls, an evaluation of risk, and its documented procurement procedures.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses a requirement indicated by 'must be authorized or not prohibited'.
unit_attributes.statement: The micro-purchase threshold used by the recipient or subrecipient must be authorized or not prohibited under State, local, or tribal laws or regulations.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may establish'.
unit_attributes.statement: The recipient or subrecipient may establish a threshold higher than the Federal threshold established in the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) in accordance with paragraphs (a)(1)(iv) and (v) of this section.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission to self-certify up to $50,000 paired with mandatory documentation requirements indicated by 'may self-certify' and 'must maintain'/'must include'.
unit_attributes.statement: The recipient or subrecipient may self-certify a threshold up to $50,000 on an annual basis and must maintain documentation to be made available to the Federal agency or pass-through entity and auditors in accordance with § 200.334. The self-certification must include a justification, clear identification of the threshold, and supporting documentation of any of the following: (A) a qualification as a low-risk auditee in accordance with the criteria in § 200.520 for the most recent audit; (B) an annual internal institutional risk assessment to identify, mitigate, and manage financial risks; or (C) for public institutions, that a higher threshold is consistent with State law.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirements indicated by 'must be approved' and 'must submit'.
unit_attributes.statement: Micro-purchase thresholds higher than $50,000 must be approved by the cognizant agency for indirect costs, and the recipient or subrecipient must submit a request that includes the requirements in paragraph (a)(1)(iv) of this section. The increased threshold is valid until any factor relied on in the establishment and rationale changes.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses an obligation indicated by 'must be obtained'.
unit_attributes.statement: If simplified acquisition procedures are used (where the aggregate dollar amount of the procurement transaction is higher than the micro-purchase threshold but does not exceed the simplified acquisition threshold), price or rate quotations must be obtained from an adequate number of qualified sources.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may exercise judgment'.
unit_attributes.statement: Unless specified by the Federal agency, when simplified acquisition procedures are used, the recipient or subrecipient may exercise judgment in determining what number of qualified sources is adequate.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses responsibility and a strict limit ('must not exceed').
unit_attributes.statement: The recipient or subrecipient is responsible for determining an appropriate simplified acquisition threshold based on internal controls, an evaluation of risk, and its documented procurement procedures, which may be lower than, but must not exceed, the threshold established in the FAR.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory application indicated by 'are required'.
unit_attributes.statement: Formal procurement methods are required when the value of the procurement transaction under a Federal award exceeds the simplified acquisition threshold of the recipient or subrecipient.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses an advisory recommendation indicated by 'should be present'.
unit_attributes.statement: For sealed bidding to be feasible, the following conditions should be present: (A) a complete, adequate, and realistic specification or purchase description is available; (B) two or more responsible bidders have been identified as willing and able to compete effectively for the business; and (C) the procurement lends itself to a firm-fixed-price contract, and the selection of the successful bidder can be made principally based on price.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement indicated by 'must be solicited'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, bids must be solicited from an adequate number of qualified sources, providing them with sufficient response time prior to the date set for opening the bids.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may exercise judgment'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, unless specified by the Federal agency, the recipient or subrecipient may exercise judgment in determining what number of qualified sources is adequate.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement for local governments indicated by 'must be publicly advertised'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, for local governments, the invitation for bids must be publicly advertised.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement indicated by 'must define'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, the invitation for bids must define the items or services with specific information, including any required specifications, for the bidder to properly respond.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement for local governments indicated by 'must be opened publicly'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, all bids will be opened at the time and place prescribed in the invitation for bids, and for local governments, the bids must be opened publicly.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement indicated by 'must be considered'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, when specified in the invitation for bids, factors such as discounts, transportation cost, and life-cycle costs must be considered in determining which bid is the lowest.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory restriction indicated by 'must only be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, payment discounts must only be used to determine the low bid when the recipient or subrecipient determines they are a valid factor based on prior experience.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory obligation indicated by 'must document and provide'.
unit_attributes.statement: If sealed bids are used, the recipient or subrecipient must document and provide a justification for all bids it rejects.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory requirement indicated by 'require' and 'must be identified'.
unit_attributes.statement: When proposals are used, requests for proposals require public notice, and all evaluation factors and their relative importance must be identified.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory solicitation requirement indicated by 'must be solicited'.
unit_attributes.statement: When proposals are used, proposals must be solicited from multiple qualified entities.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory consideration standard indicated by 'must be considered'.
unit_attributes.statement: When proposals are used, to the maximum extent practicable, any proposals submitted in response to the public notice must be considered.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory procedural requirement indicated by 'must have'.
unit_attributes.statement: When proposals are used, the recipient or subrecipient must have written procedures for conducting technical evaluations and making selections.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses mandatory award requirement indicated by 'must be awarded'.
unit_attributes.statement: When proposals are used, contracts must be awarded to the responsible offeror whose proposal is most advantageous to the recipient or subrecipient considering price and other factors.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses permission indicated by 'may use'.
unit_attributes.statement: The recipient or subrecipient may use competitive proposal procedures for qualifications-based procurement of architectural/engineering (A/E) professional services whereby the offeror's qualifications are evaluated, and the most qualified offeror is selected, subject to negotiation of fair and reasonable compensation.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses an explicit prohibition indicated by 'may not be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: The qualifications-based proposal method where price is not used as a selection factor can only be used to procure architectural/engineering (A/E) professional services, and may not be used to purchase other services provided by A/E firms that are a potential source to perform the proposed effort.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Expresses a conditional permission restricted to exclusive circumstances ('may only be used if').
unit_attributes.statement: The noncompetitive procurement method may only be used if one of the following circumstances applies: (1) the aggregate amount of the procurement transaction does not exceed the micro-purchase threshold (see paragraph (a)(1) of this section); (2) the procurement transaction can only be fulfilled by a single source; (3) the public exigency or emergency for the requirement will not permit a delay resulting from providing public notice of a competitive solicitation; (4) the recipient or subrecipient requests in writing to use a noncompetitive procurement method, and the Federal agency or pass-through entity provides written approval; or (5) after soliciting several sources, competition is determined inadequate.
